title: Fluorescent sensor-modified polyvinyl alcohol films for the detection of amine vapor based on PET (photo-induced electron transfer)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36165-36174
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05520B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kazuki Tao, Keiichi Imato, Yousuke Ooyama
The photo-induced electron transfer (PET)-type fluorescent sensor TF-2-modified polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) film can be used as a fluorescent material for the detection of volatile amines released from decomposing matter during food spoilage.
